RMSG01.name: Main guideline: accept generic, return specific
key_ideas: Accept the most generic argument type that supports the operation.
Return the most specific useful type so callers keep richer capabilities.
Returning too generic can force casts and leak implementation knowledge.

RMSG02.name: .NET generic/collection hierarchy and immutable collection consequence
key_ideas: C# variance helps explain input/output generic positions.
Collection interfaces form a hierarchy; choose the least constraining input abstraction.
Returned collections should be immutable/read-only when possible to avoid mutation bugs.
